item.title: China AI Roundup: May 2026 – DeepSeek Cuts Prices, Qwen 3.7 Launches, Embodied AI Explodes
item.description: May 2026 China AI developments recap: DeepSeek V4 Pro permanently drops to 25% of original price, R1 model cuts hallucinations by 50%; Alibaba Cloud Summit launches Qwen 3.7 series and in-house Zhenwu M890 AI chip; embodied AI market exceeds 1 trillion yuan, humanoid robots enter commercial use.
